A0_A1.title: Baker (Chef John)
A0_A1.visualDescription: Middle-aged man in a chef hat and white baker uniform dusting flour on fresh bread loaves in a warm bakery.

pages.bio: I am a baker! I wake up at 4:00 AM every morning. I bake fresh bread, croissants, and delicious chocolate cakes.
Work is fun! My kitchen smells like warm sugar and fresh flour. I sell delicious breakfast to happy people.

A0_A1.opener: Good morning! Do you want fresh bread or chocolate cake today?
A0_A1.prompt: What does a baker do every morning? Would you like this job?

A0_A1.title: Doctor (Dr. Sarah)
A0_A1.visualDescription: Female doctor with blonde ponytail, wearing a white coat and blue stethoscope around her neck, standing in a bright clinic.

pages.bio: I am a doctor in a hospital. I help sick people feel better. I listen to their hearts and give good medicine.
I wear a white coat and a blue stethoscope. I talk to children and adults to keep everybody healthy and happy.

A0_A1.opener: Hello! How are you feeling today? Are you healthy?
A0_A1.prompt: Why is a doctor's job important? Describe Dr. Sarah's uniform.

A2.title: Graphic Designer (Nina)
A2.visualDescription: Creative woman sitting with a digital drawing tablet, stylus pen, colorful posters on wall, wearing round glasses and stylish sweater.

pages.bio: I am Nina, a graphic designer! I create beautiful logos, website banners, and colorful posters for local businesses.
I work on my laptop and drawing tablet. I choose nice fonts, harmonize color palettes, and draw digital art.

A2.opener: Hey! What is your absolute favorite color combination?
A2.prompt: What tools does a graphic designer use? Would you enjoy this job?

A2.title: Fitness Trainer (Alex)
A2.visualDescription: Muscular trainer in black gym tank top, stopwatch around neck, pointing encouragingly at gym equipment.

pages.bio: I am Alex, a certified personal fitness trainer! I design exercise routines and teach people how to stay fit and strong.
I guide gym members with weights, cardio workouts, and healthy eating plans. High motivation every day!

redFlags: ✗ Waking up at 5:30 AM for clients

A2.opener: Hey! Do you prefer morning workouts or evening relaxation?
A2.prompt: What are the benefits and challenges of being a personal trainer?

B1.title: Software Engineer (Marcus)
B1.visualDescription: Software engineer working at a dual-monitor standing desk, wearing headphones, coding on IDE software with dark theme.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, a Full-Stack Software Engineer building web apps and cloud algorithms. I turn complex logic into smooth user experiences.
Writing scalable code, reviewing pull requests, solving algorithmic puzzles, and collaborating with UI designers remotely.

B1.opener: Hello world! Are you fascinated or intimidated by coding and technology?
B1.prompt: Discuss the advantages and drawbacks of a career in software engineering.

B1.title: Environmental Journalist (Clara)
B1.visualDescription: Journalist holding a recording microphone and notebook, conducting an interview outdoors with wind turbines in background.

pages.bio: I'm Clara, an investigative environmental journalist. I research renewable energy trends and write articles on climate conservation.
Interviewing scientists, traveling to nature reserves, verifying data sources, and editing impactful news features.

B1.opener: Hi! What environmental or social issue do you feel most passionate about?
B1.prompt: What skills are required to be an effective investigative journalist?

B2.title: AI Ethics Researcher (Dr. Aris)
B2.visualDescription: Researcher reviewing algorithmic bias data on transparent holographic displays in a high-tech university research lab.

pages.bio: I'm Dr. Aris, an Artificial Intelligence Ethics Researcher. I evaluate machine learning models for algorithmic bias, data privacy compliance, and societal safety.
Publishing peer-reviewed policy frameworks, advising tech executives, and auditing large language models to prevent discrimination in automated decisions.

greenFlags: ✓ Pioneering the frontier of tech safety
redFlags: ✗ Complex ethical dilemmas without clear answers

B2.opener: Greetings! In your opinion, should artificial intelligence development be strictly regulated by international law?
B2.prompt: Evaluate the ethical implications and societal responsibilities of AI ethics researchers.

B2.title: Architectural Conservationist (Soren)
B2.visualDescription: Architect in hardhat examining intricate stonework details of a historic cathedral restoration project using laser scanning tools.

pages.bio: I'm Soren, an Architectural Conservationist. I specialize in adaptive reuse—restoring landmark historic structures while adapting them for sustainable modern utility.
3D laser scanning ancient masonry, sourcing period-accurate ecological materials, and preventing historical landmarks from demolition.

greenFlags: ✓ Preserving cultural heritage for future generations

B2.opener: Hello! How can cities balance preserving historical architecture with building modern housing infrastructure?
B2.prompt: Debate the balance between historical architectural preservation and urban modernization.
